name: @waste/routing
description: The routing-provider adapter (#39, decided on #124/#132; ADR-0006's optimiser package): the provider interface every routing call goes through — measure a point sequence into legs of LineString, metres and seconds, optimise a stop set from a depot — and the deterministic fake provider CI and the tests run against (#131: no OpenRouteService credential exists on the public repository), selected by ROUTING_PROVIDER. The fake draws straight legs, measures them by haversine at a fixed speed, optimises by nearest-neighbour from the depot (visibly different from input order) and takes a scripted quota state for the quota engine's tests (S3, #171). Server-only: the API and the worker call it; apps/web is fenced out in eslint.config.mjs the way @waste/db is. Depends on @waste/contracts (the geometry it returns) and @waste/domain (the fingerprint's rules). Ships TypeScript source for tsx consumers.
